## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Data integrity

- [ ] No remote-write behavior changed.
- [ ] Or: remote-write identity, preconditions, allowed fields, protected fields and verification are documented.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend builds.
- [ ] Production/version verification passes.
- [ ] Regression test added or updated when applicable.

## Release impact

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for production-facing behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private ADIF logs or generated binaries committed.
